# Rapportperioden når sin spets – ”Ännu en kalasrapport”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-22  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon's report special on 22 Oct 2026, one of the busiest days of the Q3 reporting season, with banks a main focus. SEB paused its buybacks after higher capital requirements from the financial regulator (FI). Swedbank had a slightly soft net interest income, offset by credit loss recoveries and approval of its risk models. The hosts see cracks forming in the AI trade and expect defensive stocks and consumer companies to gain. Hexatronic and Lyko stood out as the strongest reports, with turnaround stories in Afry, Axfood and Dometic and a mixed reaction to Thule.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HTRO — Hexatronic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Blowout report: 33% growth, data center +44% organic, EBIT nearly doubled; stock weak into the report on AI worries.

#### Reasoning

Peter Hedlund (EFN journalist) calls it the report of the day and expects Hexatronic to be rewarded for its data center exposure. Fiber in North America is strong, the action programme is working, and cash flow and margin both improved. A European fiber recovery is extra upside. The stock was weak going into the report, which leaves room for a re-rating.

#### Sell Triggers

- data center growth slows
- European fiber weakness deepens
- AI capex sentiment collapses

> *"Hexatronic tror jag kan bli dagens vinnare. Kursen har gått lite svagt in i rapporten dessutom för den här AI-oron."*

---

### 🟢 LYKO-A — Lyko | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

24% growth, margin 5.6% from 0.3%; savings programme working, more savings to come; seasonally strong Q4.

#### Reasoning

The EFN journalist gave a buy recommendation at 90 kr a month ago. The stock is now ~107 and he still expects a further boost. Growth has returned and is filling the new warehouse capacity, and the cost cuts are showing up in the margin. He warns that the year-on-year comparison flatters, since last year's quarter was weak.

#### Sell Triggers

- growth slows again
- warehouse capacity remains underutilised
- margin gains fade

> *"Jag skrev köpdräkt på den här på 90 kr för en månad sedan. Nu står den väl på 107 någonstans. Men jag tror ändå den kan få en viss skjuts idag också."*

---

### 🟢 AFRY — Afry | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Beat on sales and profit, utilisation up, order book growing after 5-6 weak reports; Lasse holds a small position.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lasse Lundgren owns a small position and hopes the multi-year restructuring is finally turning around. The panel thinks the heavily sold-off stock could get a lift, although organic growth is still negative and the CEO and organisation have been questioned.

#### Sell Triggers

- organic growth stays negative
- order intake reverses
- further management turmoil

> *"Men vi har ett litet innehav i Afry som kom här. Det var en bra rapport och förhoppningsvis så ser det ut att vända."*

---

### 🟡 AXFO — Axfood | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Beat expectations, City Gross profitable, Hemköp strong, but Willys losing market share; P/E 23; Coop price push.

#### Reasoning

The journalist thinks worries about Willys will hold the stock back despite the beat, and at P/E 23 it is not cheap. Lasse hopes for a turnaround and notes Axfood/Willys could win if a price-increase cycle starts. The stock traded down on the report.

#### Sell Triggers

- Willys market share losses accelerate
- Coop price war compresses margins

> *"Den kanske går upp men den kommer hållas tillbaka av att Willys fortsatt går lite trögt."*

---

### 🟠 DOM — Dometic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

First organic growth in 18 quarters, 4bn impairment, new savings programme; ND/EBITDA 3.4 vs 2.5 target; P/E ~7; stock -50% YTD.

#### Reasoning

High leverage gives the share price strong upside if things improve, and the stock is very depressed at a forward P/E of ~7. Panelists think it could bounce. However, the US RV market is down 14% YTD, which makes a real recovery hard before end demand returns.

#### Sell Triggers

- US RV market keeps declining
- leverage fails to fall toward 2.5x
- organic growth reverses

> *"Ja, men jag tror den skulle kunna göra det. Tittar på nästa års vinstförväntningar så ligger P12 på 7 ungefär."*

---

### 🟠 THULE — Thule | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Organic growth 1.2% vs 3% expected, margin 17.3% vs 20% target; board turmoil; not a disaster.

#### Reasoning

There was no 'bomb' behind the board revolt, and the strong brands and products are holding up. But the miss on organic growth is likely to be punished in the short term, and governance uncertainty around the CEO remains.

#### Sell Triggers

- CEO departure
- further organic growth misses

> *"en organisk tillväxt på 1,2 när man förväntat sig en tillväxt på 3 % – det kommer man att straffas för."*

---

### 🟡 SWED-A — Swedbank | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Credit risk models approved, buffer 215bp and set to grow 0.6pp; ROE 15.6%; room to pay out full dividend.

#### Reasoning

Lasse sees the model approvals as very positive. The buffer is above the ~200bp reference point, so Swedbank could pay out everything under its 60-70% dividend policy, unlike SEB with its paused buybacks. NII was a little soft, and mortgage margins are very tight with a hesitant market.

#### Sell Triggers

- new regulatory capital add-ons
- NII declines further
- Baltic model changes consume capital

> *"Men vi har ju 215 punkter över buffert... så att man ligger över målet vilket betyder att man skulle kunna dela ut allting."*

---

### 🟡 ESSITY-B — Essity | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Defensive appeal amid AI doubts; better adjusted result but four quarters of falling margins, weak consumer tissue.

#### Reasoning

Hosts think defensive names like Essity should do well in a nervous market, and Lasse called the result fairly strong with cost savings offsetting headwinds. The journalist doubts a consumer tissue sale will drive much value while that unit's profitability is falling. Price increases take 1-2 quarters to come through.

#### Sell Triggers

- margins keep declining
- price increases fail to catch up with cost inflation
- shift to private label

> *"Det var ett ganska starkt resultat. Jag tror att man har varit mer orolig."*

---

### 🟠 ELISA — Elisa | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell 4% on its report; starting to look attractive on valuation as a safe telecom.

#### Reasoning

A host remarks in passing that after the drop the Finnish telecom starts to look attractive on valuation for those seeking safe stocks in turbulent times.

#### Sell Triggers

- further earnings disappointments

> *"Handlades ner 4 % på sin rapport. Man börjar se attraktivt ut värderingsmässigt."*
